content.title: Sixers vs. Magic: Game Preview, Injury Report | Oct. 27, 2025
content.text: When the media asked VJ Edgecombe to describe how he was feeling soon after the Philadelphia 76ers selected him No. 3 overall in the 2025 NBA Draft, he vowed that the work wouldn’t stop."I don't have no words,” Edgecombe said at the time. “It's just surreal. I work hard, and everything is paying off. But the work don't stop… I'm focused on playing now.”And play he did in his NBA debut Wednesday, Oct. 22, 2025, at TD Garden in Boston. He started, in fact – and the 20-year-old from the Bahamas delivered a performance for the books.Edgecombe joined Tyrese Maxey in leading the Sixers to a 117-116 opening-night victory over the Celtics.Historic CompanyEdgecombe scored 34 points in 42 minutes – the most ever by a 76ers rookie in his debut.The 2024 Allen Iverson National High School Player of the Year outscored Iverson, who put up 30 against Milwaukee in the 1996 opener.The 34 points were also the third most by any rookie in an NBA debut, trailing only Wilt Chamberlain (43 in 1959) and Frank Selvy (35 in 1954).Maxey scored a game-high 40 points to tie Hall of Famer Hal Greer for the franchise record in a season opener. Edgecombe and Maxey posted similar shooting lines – 13-for-26 and 13-for-24, respectively. Maxey made seven 3-pointers and Edgecombe added five.Edgecombe scored 14 points in the first quarter, surpassing LeBron James’ NBA rookie debut record of 12 first-quarter points in 2003.Maxey took over in the second quarter with 19 of his 22 first-half points. It was the fifth time in Maxey’s now six-year NBA career that he’s scored at least 19 points in a single frame.“I think it will just grow over time,” Maxey said of the backcourt partnership. “But we’ve got a lot of weapons… We’ve got some talent on this team, but we’ve just got to put it all together. We’ve got to continue to play hard, play fast, play the right way. I think today we played the right way.”Video Player is loading.Current Time 0:00Duration 2:27Remaining Time 2:27Rookie VJ Edgecombe Records 34 Points in NBA Debut‘They Love Basketball’Veteran teammate Kyle Lowry – who just embarked on his 20th NBA season – said on media day that he still considers the soon-to-be 25-year-old Maxey one of the young guys. Lowry appreciates this group of young players that certainly includes Edgecombe as well.“I just think we have really good young guys,” Lowry said. “And they have this openness and happiness and this spirit that’s just … pureness. They love basketball. They want to work. They get in the gym early, they listen to the coaches, they listen to the advice I give them… They're looking forward to how to get better.”Humble and HungryThe NBA season is long, but the 2025-26 Sixers started it on the right foot.“From a team standpoint, we got the win, which matters the most,” said Edgecombe, who shared two of the Sixers’ posts on his Instagram story after the game. The first was the final score graphic, to which he added “Good dub.” The second was a photo of him and Maxey, showing the caption “74 combined points for this duo.”Edgecombe is humble and hungry.“I work every day and all my life for moments like these,” he said. “This is my dream. I prayed for this. I always prayed to just make it to the NBA – and to stay in the NBA.”Did it live up to his expectations?“Man, yeah, that was crazy. That surpassed my expectations, to be honest.”
